string-array.name: changelog_49
string-array.item: Xonos inside myCar now sails with the engine of Xonos 0.1.55: skips come up to a second quicker, an artist opens at once (its songs come aboard when ye open them), and the ship\'s menu waits for Music Assistant instead of showing empty holds.
With Music Assistant on yer phone, in the Xonos app: playing, skipping and picking a song wait up to a minute while it hoists sail again, instead of crying it ain\'t connected.

Sturdier Xonos: a sound decoder that springs a leak is swapped out, the sign-in is renewed before it runs dry, and Spotify, left tied up in Music Assistant by a stream nobody hears any more, cuts itself loose.

If the car is switched off while the network is down, Xonos no longer strikes up again on the phone\'s speaker when the network returns. Its lines in the ship\'s log no longer hold songs, searches or addresses.

string-array.name: changelog_48
string-array.item: Autoplay no longer strikes up the shanties on the phone\'s speaker, down in yer pocket, when the ship\'s Bluetooth music ain\'t aboard yet: it waits up to a minute, and a pause or a song ye pick meanwhile stays.

string-array.name: changelog_47
string-array.item: The chart no longer goes black and loses its position when the ship\'s Wi-Fi drops and comes back mid-voyage, or when ye board while myCar is left open on the locked phone. Steady as she goes!
With pirate speak, the voice and the phone numbers follow yer phone\'s home port again.

string-array.name: changelog_46
string-array.item: Fixed a crash that sank myCar and ended the voyage: it struck after a tap in Plancia\'s page, then a turn to the chart or the fleet, the Plancia app taking its place, or a change of paint.
Pirate speak: in Rigging > Tongue, every text of myCar in pirate terms, in yer own tongue. We chart our own course and bow to no crown.
A fresh moving wallpaper, myCar · Rebel: the waves, and a pirate ship that rides out every storm, skull and crossbones flying high.
If myCar ever closes by itself, the next start writes in the ship\'s log why Android scuttled it (a crash, memory, not responding), so the hole can be patched.
The parrot\'s voice models come aboard one at a time, never once the voyage is over, and before the first command only with memory to spare in the hold.
Wee shanty box: on small screens it sets out clear of the chart\'s buttons, let go under them it drifts just clear, and the chart\'s faded buttons no longer steal taps meant for the chart.
Verses: every shanty starts from its first line, and a live version of another shanty no longer smuggles in its words.
Spotify and the other shanty services: \"play …\" waits up to 25 seconds for the page, and a Play still waiting doesn\'t start once you\'ve switched shanties.

Choosing the ship\'s radio stops a video or a radio playing in Cinema or the browser, and they don\'t start again by themselves. Autoplay strikes up the shanties only once the sound has a course to the ship.

Parrot: \"next\", \"pause\" or \"stop\" inside a longer question no longer change the shanty; \"don\'t send\" and \"cancel\" are heard while you answer a message; a pause right before another shanty command no longer cancels it.
Fresh plunder waits for a call to end, and during a call the decks beside the chart and their menu stay below the call\'s bar.
Changing myCar\'s tongue mid-voyage switches the helm at once; on Android 12 and 13, opening myCar mid-voyage gives the chart its position back.
